lines.zh: 我从林子里滑出来，很快。
lines.en: I slide out of the trees, quick.

lines.zh: 我的身体左右扭，像一根鞭。
lines.en: I whip side to side like a cord.

lines.zh: 我绕过树干，几乎不减速。
lines.en: I bend around a trunk without slowing.

lines.zh: 我的鳞片在阴影里泛红。
lines.en: My scales glow red in the shade.

lines.zh: 我把头压得很低，往前冲。
lines.en: I keep my head low and push forward.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面滑过一片落叶。
lines.en: I skim over a sheet of fallen leaves.

lines.zh: 我爬过一段热石头，很舒服。
lines.en: I cross a warm stone. It feels good.

lines.zh: 我抬头扫了一眼，又低下去。
lines.en: I glance up once, then drop low.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴扫得草叶直抖。
lines.en: My tail makes the grass tremble.
I'm looking for something to pounce on.

lines.zh: 我走得不慢，猎手都这样。
lines.en: I don't move slowly. Hunters don't.
I squeeze through a gap in the brush.

lines.zh: 我的路线比普通蛇更直。
lines.en: My path is straighter than a plain snake's.
I coil with my head up.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在扫这片林子。
lines.en: My eyes sweep the woods.
I press my body to the warm stone.

lines.zh: 我在等一个小东西跑过。
lines.en: I wait for something small to run past.
My tongue flicks quickly.
Someone's in the woods. I heard.

lines.zh: 我的肌肉绷着，随时能弹。
lines.en: My muscles stay taut, ready to spring.
I'm not as idle as other snakes.
I wind myself tighter.

lines.zh: 树叶落在我头上，我没动。
lines.en: A leaf lands on my head; I don't move.
I'm measuring the distance to lunge.
The scents here are strong.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，又转向另一边。
lines.en: I raise my head and turn it aside.
My prey had better not be too big.
I coil and do not blink once.
You're a bit bigger than I expected.
I can place this smell.

lines.zh: 你站在那里，正好在射程里。
lines.en: You stand right in my reach.
I raise my head and look at your feet.
Are you hunter or prey?
I don't hiss. I lunge.
You smell of chicken.
I've watched that hand a long while.
I know the smell of chicken.
These woods are my hunting ground.

lines.zh: 我慢慢绕着你走了半圈。
lines.en: I circle halfway around you.
Your boots look tough.
I raise my head and meet your eyes.
What's funny? I'm serious.

lines.zh: 我这一身火色，是猎手的。
lines.en: This fire-colored coat marks a hunter.
You move first, or I?
My scales have spread a little.
Your scent excites me.
I'm hungry. You'd best back off.
I coil up slowly.
I spring up in pain.
A few scales are cracked.
I retreat fast behind a stone.

lines.zh: 这一下把我的劲打散了。
lines.en: That knocked the drive out of me.
I flatten out and gasp.
My head swims.
I coil tighter.
You hit fast and true.
I'm starting to think of running.
Hunters get hurt too.
Raw chicken and I come at once.
I smell that meat.

lines.zh: 你把肉举起来，我抬了头。
lines.en: You lift the meat and my head rises.
I'm quick. Don't blink.
That smell is more than I can resist.
I lunge once, then stop.
I wind over to your hand.
This smells better than prey.
I wait for you to let go.
I edge closer, carefully.
Give it here, and I won't bite.
I coil at your feet and look up.
This scent makes me forget the fight.
One more sniff is all I want.
Your palm is sweating, and it smells better.
I open my mouth and don't bite.
A full belly makes me gentle.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，我立刻缠上去。
lines.en: You bump me and I coil on at once.
I slip away and round behind you.
My tail is pinned, and I turn to bite.

lines.zh: 猎人变种，咬得比普通的小蛇狠。
lines.en: The hunter morph bites harder than most Nillos.
I wrap your ankle, tight.
You kick and throw me off.
I roll over and rear up.
That touch and I recoil at once.

lines.zh: 我攀着你的护腿往上爬。
lines.en: I climb your greaves.
Don't grab me with your hand.
Another hunter slides near.
We circle each other once.
It moves faster than I.
Our heads touch, lightly.
Its scent is familiar.
We lie in the brush together.
Neither of us moves; we only watch.
Our tails cross.
Two hunters. A good pair.

lines.zh: 明天我们一起巡这片林。
lines.en: Tomorrow we'll hunt these woods together.
I snap up the meat.
I roll the coin under my body.
I snatch it and back away.
Wrong smell. I drop it.

lines.zh: 我一卷尾巴，东西就到手。
lines.en: One curl of my tail and it is mine.
I swallow half and it sticks.

lines.zh: 我这猎手变种，牙比普通的长。
lines.en: This hunter morph has longer fangs.
I'll keep this meat.

lines.zh: 我叼着肉，眼睛还盯着你。
lines.en: I hold the meat and keep my eyes on you.
I clamp down and will not let go.
I've moved. You're too late.
Every leaf here answers to me.

lines.zh: 全身绷紧，爪子抠进土里。
lines.en: Every muscle tight, claws dug into soil.
I raise my head, and not to chat.
At this range, one lunge.
You didn't back off fast enough.
I begin to circle.

lines.zh: 丛林里的热气，我顺着追。
lines.en: I chase the warm air through the jungle.
There's no one else in these woods.

lines.zh: 你的脚跟一抬，我就知道了。
lines.en: The moment your heel lifts, I know.
The grass flattens as I slip along.

lines.zh: 你一转，我已经在另一边。
lines.en: You turn, and I'm already elsewhere.
I press the grass flat, silent.
The moment your knee bends, I move.
I slip behind the brush.

lines.zh: 这一带我熟得像自己的窝。
lines.en: I know this ground like my own den.
Each circle brings me closer.

lines.zh: 你的影子在地上，我跟着。
lines.en: Your shadow's on the ground; I follow.
I raise my head and measure the height.
One more step and I stop waiting.
I clamp onto the edge of your knee guard.
I throw my whole body around you.
Quick and hard.
You kick; I let go and bite again.
I spring up and bite your fingers.
I spring off and land on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你把我扯下来，皮都撕了。
lines.en: You tear me off, and scales rip.
I recoil and ready another.

lines.zh: 我的牙还留着你的味道。
lines.en: Your taste stays in my teeth.
A hunter never bites just once.
The brush rustles and I dart out.
I slide down from the tree.

lines.zh: 林子里多了一条红鳞的蛇。
lines.en: A red-scaled snake has joined the woods.
I coil behind a stone and wait.

lines.zh: 草叶上有一条浅浅的痕。
lines.en: A shallow track runs through the grass.

lines.zh: 我在阳光最好的地方出现。
lines.en: I appear where the sun falls best.
I raise my head and look first.

lines.zh: 这里的猎场空着，我占了。
lines.en: The hunting ground was empty. I took it.
I rise from the leaf litter.
My scales carry heat.

lines.zh: 火烫着我的鳞，我扭得厉害。
lines.en: Fire sears my scales and I thrash.

lines.zh: 我从树上摔下，砸在叶子上。
lines.en: I fall from the tree into the leaves.

lines.zh: 水让我喘不上气，我挣着。
lines.en: Water chokes me and I struggle.
The blast hurls me a long way.

lines.zh: 一支箭把我钉在树根上。
lines.en: An arrow pins me to a root.
That spell freezes me in place.

lines.zh: 太久没猎到东西，我虚了。
lines.en: Too long without a kill; I'm weak.

lines.zh: 雷落下来，我整条都抽紧了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my body snaps taut.

lines.zh: 虚空把我卷下去，我缠空了。
lines.en: The void rolls me down and I grip nothing.
